leakage_rules.target_read_scope: delta_dice AND gain_category are read ONLY from the joined table for (a) FIT rows (training target) and (b) EARLY_STOP rows (checkpoint selection metric). They are NEVER read for OUTER_TARGET rows.
leakage_rules.outcome_access_barrier: Membership (K=1239) is derived from delta_hat ONLY, frozen and hashed BEFORE any outcome join. Enforced in a separate post-barrier step (phase28_router_membership_barrier.json).
leakage_rules.fold_ownership: each OUTER_TARGET sample is predicted ONLY by the fold model whose outer_target contains it; never final.pt; no final refit
leakage_rules.normalization_fit_only: mu/sigma computed on FIT_k only; applied to ES_k and OT_k

static_check.note: Both are read for the joined table construction. The OOF prediction section writes ONLY delta_hat; the target arrays (y_all) are consumed exclusively via fit_idx and es_idx slices.
